objective: Fill out the entire tower (all floors) furnished, and with actual structure; right now the rooms kind of feel empty

evidence: geometry.json: all five floors and 19 per-room furnishing inventories
requirements.details: Original furniture retains uniform proportions; secondary work, storage and seating zones fill spare bay dimensions. Furniture bounds exclude architectural floors and walls. Every room spans at least 72% of each usable bay dimension.

requirements.requirement: Add actual architectural structure across the floors
requirements.details: Full room finishes, solid cutaway partitions, open door frames, window bays, columns/spandrels and a furnished continuous hall. Tests sample actual floor/wall meshes and raycast all door landings/corridors; shared plan coordinates drive reading/cap drawings.
All five complete floor overviews were inspected. Rear-wing cut faces and cabinets remain low enough to expose the main furniture. Portrait and landscape night views were also reviewed.

requirements.requirement: Preserve navigation, framing and bounded rendering
requirements.details: Five integration modes and all 26 GPU views pass on each of three viewports. Original raster/detail budgets remain in place. Idle adds zero frames; navigation/resize allocations stabilize; geometry/textures dispose fully.

limitations: Browser viewport simulations, not physical-phone testing
